cover_letter:
Dear Whale team,

I'm writing to apply for the Growth Marketer role. Whale's mission to help companies onboard faster and stop losing knowledge resonates with me, and the job description—owning activation, lifecycle, and conversion experiments while being genuinely AI-native—describes the way I already work.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage SEO content and CMS publishing for client websites, using Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to track what moves. I've built and optimized sites like mirook.com, where I implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file, and ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. Freelance, I designed and built baverok.com from scratch—a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, structured data, and a free site-check enquiry flow—so I'm comfortable wiring my own stack.

I'm AI-native in practice: I use LLMs daily for research, content, and audits, and I've built automations with Python and MCP integrations into WordPress and SEO tools. I also have an Android app live on Google Play, which shows I can ship and finish. My HubSpot Content Marketing certification and front-end background (AngularJS, JavaScript) mean I can set up automations and analytics without waiting on engineering.

I write clear, human copy that converts, and I stay organized with a lot in flight. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Whale's growth engine.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
